query:
SELECT id,
                       room_id as "room_id: RoomId",
                       user_id as "user_id: UserId",
                       content,
                       message_type AS "message_type: ChatMessageType",
                       created_at
                FROM chat_messages
                WHERE room_id = $1 AND (created_at, id) < ($2, $3)
                ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
                LIMIT $4::int4
